data.title: Cambodia and Thailand begin UN-backed conciliation on maritime dispute
data.description: Foreign ​ministers of Cambodia and Thailand delivered opening statements on Tuesday at the first ​meeting of a UN arbitration ‌process to resolve a long-running maritime dispute between the two Southeast Asian neighbours.

data.title: Thailand moves to end 'world waste bin' image
data.description: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin on Monday led a search operation targeting an illegal waste disposal network at Laem Chabang Port in Chon Buri, vowing to end Thailand's reputation as the world's waste bin.

data.title: Somchart seeks further delay
data.description: People's Party (PP) Phuket MP Somchart Techathavorncharoen has postponed giving testimony to the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) for a third time in a probe into the alleged use of nominees to hold property for foreign nationals in Phuket.

data.title: Klong Toey oil residue 'stable'
data.description: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Monday that oil residue in drainage pipes in Klong Toey district had not increased significantly, while authorities worked to identify its source.

data.title: Cooperation 'key' to resilience
data.description: Asean must make better use of its combined market, deepen economic integration and ensure that smaller businesses share in regional growth if it is to remain competitive amid geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruption, business leaders told the 2026 World Knowledge Forum (WKF).

data.title: Fund proposes platform to tax online content creators
data.description: The Thai Media Fund has proposed creating a national platform to generate income and collect taxes from social media influencers and content creators.

data.title: BMA clarifies Jewish site role
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has clarified that its authority over a proposed Jewish Association of Thailand building in Sukhumvit Soi 22 is limited to building control, while permits for cemeteries or crematoria require applicants to have lawful rights over the land.

data.title: MoU signed to boost semiconductor job openings
data.description: The government on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to develop human resources for the semiconductor industry, targeting the training of 10,000 highly skilled manufacturing workers over five years.

data.title: US to fund subsea cable connect study
data.description: The US Trade and Development Agency announced funding on Monday for a feasibility study to develop a trusted trans-Pacific submarine cable system that connects Thailand, through neighbouring countries, to the United States.

data.title: Customs nets B4bn from online tax levies
data.description: The Customs Department has collected more than 4 billion baht in import duties and value-added tax (VAT) on foreign online purchases since the government began taxing imported goods from the first baht on Jan 1, exceeding its initial target.

data.title: Thailand seeks a 'true partner' role within Brics
data.description: NEW DELHI: Thailand is seeking to position itself as a "true partner" of Brics, using the grouping to deepen cooperation, diversify markets and pursue new opportunities across the Global South, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

data.title: Senator calls for tighter control over temple finances
data.description: A senator on Monday urged tighter financial controls and oversight of monks after more than 92 million baht was allegedly embezzled from an Ayutthaya temple.

data.title: EC refers 77 suspects to court
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) has voted to refer 77 suspects in the alleged Senate election collusion case to the Supreme Court's Election Cases Division for criminal proceedings, including 26 sitting senators.

data.title: Opposition vows legal action against EC over alleged leniency toward Bhumjaithai
data.description: Mr Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut, leader of the opposition and the People’s Party, has vowed to take legal action against the Election Commission (EC) after it dropped charges against key political figures from the ruling Bhumjaithai Party in its case concerning alleged collusion in the Senate election.

data.title: Election Commission resolves to prosecute 77 people in Senate collusion case
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) on Monday resolved to ask the Supreme Court to hear the case against 77 people accused of collusion in the 2024 Senate election process, including 26 sitting senators.

data.title: EC resolves to prosecute 77 people in Senate collusion case
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) on Monday resolved to ask the Supreme Court toher the case against 77 people accused of collusion in the 2024 Senate election process, including 26 sitting senators.

data.title: Border fears resurface as UN starts Thai-Cambodian sea border dispute hearing
data.description: BURI RAM - Villagers in a district bordering Cambodia are worried tensions could again escalate as Thailand and Cambodia meet for the first time under a UN-faciliated process aimed at settling their disputed maritime boundary.

data.title: Appeal Court upholds class action tilapia damages suit against CPF
data.description: The Appeal Court has upheld the Bangkok South Civil Court’s decision last year to accept a class action lawsuit against Charoen Pokphand Foods Plc (CPF) seeking 2.4-billion-baht compensation for damage to the livelihoods of farmers and to the environment from the spread of invasive blackchin tilapia fish.

data.title: Weight-loss injection pens now require a doctor's prescription
data.description: Weight-loss injection pens have declared a specially controlled medication requiring a doctor's prescription and available only from pharmacies, effective from Sept 15, following reports of harmful use and unregistered sales.

data.title: No issues found during inspections of Bangkok data centres
data.description: No issues had been found during inspections of data centres in Bangkok, when monitoring measures were also explained, Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Monday.

data.title: Former THAI stewardess remanded by Australian court on heroin charge
data.description: A former Thai Airways International (THAI) stewardess appeared in an Australian court on Monday morning on a charge of heroin smuggling and was remanded in custody.

data.title: Chinese millionaire fugitive arrested in Pattaya, has fake Thai ID
data.description: A Chinese millionaire arrested in Pattaya for illegally acquiring Thai citizenship is also wanted in China for alleged assault three decades ago.

data.title: Govt clarifies aid to Cambodia
data.description: Government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises on Sunday denied Thailand had approved a new 31-million-baht aid project for Cambodia, saying the actual allocation is 18.2 million baht to cover interest payments on two previously completed infrastructure projects.

data.title: Govt rejects reports of monthly firearm licence renewals
data.description: The government on Sunday rejected reports that gun owners would have to renew their licences and pay fees every one to two months, saying the claim was not in line with proposed measures to improve firearms control.

data.title: TPO strikes a chord at concert in China
data.description: The Thailand Philharmonic Orchestra (TPO) has brought the sound of the Thai ranat ek to the Great Wall of China, performing alongside Western instruments at an outdoor concert in Beijing to mark the 51st anniversary of diplomatic ties between Thailand and China.

data.title: PM's Office rejects Wang Tanod forest allegation
data.description: The Prime Minister's Office has rejected claims by veteran commentator Sondhi Limthongkul that cabinet approval of the Wang Tanod reservoir in Chanthaburi amounts to ordering forest destruction.

data.title: Teacher accused of assaulting students
data.description: Parents of four boys in Ayutthaya have filed a police complaint alleging that a teacher assaulted them and threatened them with a knife after they failed to attend a school sports event.

data.title: Epac extends diesel refinery price cut policy
data.description: The Energy Policy Administration Committee (Epac) has extended a measure cutting the refinery price of high-speed diesel by 2.40 baht per litre from Wednesday to Oct 31, says the Royal Gazette.

data.title: PM instructs Ekniti to extend relief
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has told Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas to consider extending the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme by one to two months.

data.title: Army pledges to assist probe  into conscript's death in camp
data.description: The 2nd Army Region has pledged to cooperate fully with police and other authorities in an investigation into the death of a 20-year-old conscript found hanging from a tree at a military camp in Nakhon Ratchasima.

data.title: PP tells Pheu Thai to act on graft
data.description: People's Party (PP) deputy leader Wiroj Lakkhanaadisorn has accused Pheu Thai Party senior figure Phumtham Wechayachai of using past political disagreements as a pretext to abandon anti-corruption principles.

data.title: EC poised to show its cards
data.description: The Senate election collusion case is entering a crucial stage, with the Election Commission (EC) set to decide on Monday whether to petition the Supreme Court's Election Cases Division against those accused.

data.title: TPO strikes a chord at concert in China
data.description: The Thailand Philharmonic Orchestra (TPO) has brought the sound of the Thai ranat ek to the Great Wall of China, performing alongside Western instruments at an outdoor concert in Beijing to mark the 51st anniversary of diplomatic ties between Thailand and China.

data.title: Cafeteria ceiling collapses at costly parliament complex
data.description: A section of ceiling collapsed in a basement cafeteria at the multi-billion-baht parliament complex on Sunday, breaking tables and toppling chairs but fortunately causing no injuries because it was not a working day.

data.title: Actress links threat to her testifying about Tangmo's death
data.description: Actress Usamanee “Kwan” Waitayanon has told police she was threatened on Sunday morning, saying it might be related to her decision to give witness testimony in the death of actress Nida “Tangmo” Patcharaveerapong, who fell from a speedboat on the Chao Phraya River in 2022.

data.title: Motorists warned about scam traffic-fine SMSs
data.description: Motorists are warned not to click links or scan QR codes in SMS messages claiming they have unpaid traffic fines. The messages are a scam aimed at stealing personal and financial information.

data.title: Marchers demand mass prosecutions in senate collusion case
data.description: Supporters of Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) marched 11-kilometres through Bangkok on Sunday demanding the Election Commission submit the senate election collusion case and its 229 suspects to the Supreme Court for judgement.

data.title: Hospital apologises for cutting off toddler’s finger
data.description: The management of Loengnoktha Crown Prince Hospital has apologised after an assistant nurse accidentally cut off part of a toddler's right index finger while preparing the young patient for discharge, in the northeastern province of Yasothon.
